text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"Fist,\" \"wanna,\" \"how does it feel\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing shows more ability to form and manage complete sentences, even though there are still many errors."},{"evidence":"\"My first reason is that...\" / \"My second reason is that...\" / \"My last reason is...\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a clearer multi-paragraph structure with explicit transitions that guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"\"when I grow up\" / \"what happens when an animal get sick\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands ideas with more specific supporting detail and examples instead of repeating the same claim."},{"evidence":"\"I want to learn how you treat the animals\" / \"I would want to visit the zoo\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The writer develops the topic more fully by explaining reasons and adding related thoughts within each paragraph."}]}
